name: Parts of the Swarm
summary: Turning a cracked silithid carapace over in Thousand Needles, you find its plating interwoven so tightly that it is remarkably strong, and the creature seems powerful and highly developed. Korran at the Crossroads would probably like to study more of them.

sections.title: A Curious Carapace
sections.body: Closer inspection shows the chitin woven so tightly that it is unlike anything you have seen. The rest of the body tells the same tale of great strength and advanced development. It occurs to you that Korran, at the Crossroads, would relish examining more of these creatures to learn their nature and their origins. The specimens wanted are one silithid heart, five silithid talons and three intact silithid carapaces.

sections.title: Specimens for Korran
sections.body: Korran is pleased, remarking that these specimens, along with the eggs found in the Field of Giants, make a good start toward understanding what manner of creatures the insects are and what they seek.

faq.answer: It begins when you inspect a cracked silithid carapace in Thousand Needles.
One silithid heart, five silithid talons and three intact silithid carapaces.

faq.q: Why would Korran want to study silithid?
faq.answer: Studying more of them might show the creatures' nature and origin.

angles.text: This is a Horde matter: the specimens are Korran's to receive, at the Crossroads.
